evals.prompt:
Audit this broken `.drawio` snippet and list every rule violation before showing the corrected XML structure:
```xml
<mxfile><diagram>eJztwTEBAAAAwqD1T20ND6AAAIBLcAwAAQ==</diagram></mxfile>
<!-- Service -- Lambda & DynamoDB -->
<mxCell id="u1" value="Users" style="shape=actor;" vertex="1" parent="1"/>
<mxCell id="c1" value="AWS Lambda" style="fillColor=#FFF2E8;strokeColor=#ED7100;container=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"/>
<mxCell id="i1" value="Compute" style="shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda_function;" vertex="1" parent="c1"/>
<mxCell id="e1" value="HTTPS & Auth" edge="1" source="u1" target="c1" parent="1"/>
```
evals.expected_output: Flags all six structural/style violations and provides corrected XML: (1) compressed Base64 `<diagram>` body instead of uncompressed `<mxGraphModel grid="0">` (no hardcoded `background`); (2) `--` double hyphen inside `<!-- Service -- Lambda & DynamoDB -->` XML comment; (3) unescaped `&` in `HTTPS & Auth` (`&`) and inline edge `value` instead of a child `edgeLabel` cell (`connectable="0"`); (4) prohibited `shape=actor` instead of a visible `#f5f5f5` Users container (`strokeColor=light-dark(#666666,#D4D4D4)`, `y >= 140`); (5) **inverted labels** — container `c1` has `value="AWS Lambda"` and icon `i1` has `value="Compute"` (container must hold the category `Compute` and icon must hold `AWS Lambda`); and (6) edge `e1` targets container `c1` instead of service icon `i1`.
expectations: Activates the aws-architecture-diagram skill
Flags compressed `<diagram>` payload, `--` inside XML comments, unescaped `&` (`&`), and prohibited `shape=actor`
Flags inverted container/icon labels (`Compute` category on container vs `AWS Lambda` on icon) and edge targeting container `c1` instead of icon `i1` (plus child `edgeLabel` cell)

evals.expected_output: Executes **Mode A — Codebase Analysis**: extracts the AWS services (`CloudFront`, `AWS WAF`, `Application Load Balancer`, `ECS`, `Aurora PostgreSQL`), maps network boundaries (`Public Subnets` for ALB, `Private Subnets` for ECS tasks and Aurora cluster inside a VPC), maps non-AWS external systems (`Stripe API`, `Datadog SaaS`) as external integration containers outside the AWS Cloud group (`general-icons.md`), traces end-to-end request/egress flow, and **waits for user confirmation** before writing `.drawio` XML.
